task_description.overview: Automatically pick P-wave arrival time using the Baer picker algorithm.
steps: Load waveform data into a Trace object.
Call pk_baer(data, sampling_rate, tdownmax, tupmax, thr1, thr2, lta, sta).
Receive p_pick (sample index) and phase_info string.
Convert sample index to time by dividing by sampling_rate.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the trace samples from {waveform_data_path}. Execute pk_baer(trace_data, sampling_rate, {tdownmax}, {tupmax}, {thr1}, {thr2}, {lta}, {sta}). Plot a figure to show the waveform, and the finally picked times. Save the pick time to {pick_time.save_name} with content {pick_time.content} and the plot to {pick_plot}.
